fact: The 'second frog' — an orange giant that outshines its own constellation's alpha star.
bio: Diphda (Beta Ceti), also called Deneb Kaitos, is an orange giant about 96 light-years away. Though lettered 'Beta', it is the brightest star in Cetus, the Sea Monster, outshining the constellation's Alpha, Menkar.
cultural: The name comes from an Arabic phrase meaning 'the second frog' — distant Fomalhaut being the 'first frog'. Its alternative name, Deneb Kaitos, marks the tail of the great sea beast of the watery region of the sky.
